facts.fact: Oman is home to the Arabian oryx, a brilliant white antelope that was extinct in the wild until Oman's breeding program brought it back from the brink in the 1980s.
facts.flagElement: the white antelope silhouette in the center

facts.fact: Oman produces some of the world's finest frankincense, the aromatic resin that has been harvested from Boswellia trees in Dhofar for over 5,000 years and was once worth more than gold.
facts.flagElement: the three amber teardrops along the bottom edge

facts.fact: Oman's traditional dhow boats with their distinctive triangular lateen sails have sailed the Indian Ocean trade routes for centuries, connecting Arabia to Africa and Asia.
facts.flagElement: the large triangular sail shape on the left side
